traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills close to moderately spaced; creamy-beige to pale yellow-brown when young, becoming grey-brown to rust-brown with maturity; edges often paler
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills close to moderately spaced; creamy-beige to pale yellow-brown when young, becoming grey-brown to rust-brown with maturity; edges often paler

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to nearly flat; smooth, sometimes slightly greasy or sticky when fresh; honey-yellow, ochre-yellow to pale brownish-yellow, fading when dry; young margin may retain ephemeral white veil fragments
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to nearly flat; smooth, sometimes slightly greasy or sticky when fresh; honey-yellow, ochre-yellow to pale brownish-yellow, fading when dry; young margin may retain ephemeral white veil fragments

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnexed to narrowly adnate, sometimes with a slight decurrent tooth
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnexed to narrowly adnate, sometimes with a slight decurrent tooth

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Slender, cylindrical, whitish to pale ochre-yellow or cap-coloured; finely pruinose to fibrillose, solid when young and becoming hollow; ring absent, with white basal mycelium or fine rhizomorphs
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Slender, cylindrical, whitish to pale ochre-yellow or cap-coloured; finely pruinose to fibrillose, solid when young and becoming hollow; ring absent, with white basal mycelium or fine rhizomorphs

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print dark brown to dull cinnamon-brown
traits.raw: ⚫🟤🟠 Spore print dark brown to dull cinnamon-brown

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Saprobic in lawns, meadows, pastures, grassy parkland, roadside verges and dune grasslands; occasionally on compost, manure or woodchips; alone or gregariously; spring to autumn
traits.raw: 🍀🍂 Saprobic in lawns, meadows, pastures, grassy parkland, roadside verges and dune grasslands; occasionally on compost, manure or woodchips; alone or gregariously; spring to autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Not recommended; insubstantial, easily confused
traits.raw: 😒 Not recommended; insubstantial, easily confused

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body small; stipe ~2–8 cm long and ~0.2–0.6 cm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body small; stipe ~2–8 cm long and ~0.2–0.6 cm thick

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: Whitish, thin, unchanging when cut
traits.raw: 🔪 Whitish, thin, unchanging when cut

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: KOH red to pink on cap surface
traits.raw: 🧪 KOH red to pink on cap surface

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Faint to mealy
traits.raw: 👃 Faint to mealy

traits.label: Taste
traits.text: Mealy
traits.raw: 👅 Mealy

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores ellipsoid, smooth, thick-walled, ~9.5–15(–18) × 7–10 µm, with a conspicuous germ pore; basidia 4-spored with basal clamps; cheilocystidia lageniform to ventricose, often capitate; pleurocystidia sparse or absent
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores ellipsoid, smooth, thick-walled, ~9.5–15(–18) × 7–10 µm, with a conspicuous germ pore; basidia 4-spored with basal clamps; cheilocystidia lageniform to ventricose, often capitate; pleurocystidia sparse or absent

traits.text: Small honey-yellow grassland fieldcap with no persistent ring
